summary: 3 repair targets triaged: simplify q1, simplify q3, and drop q4 because the artifact generation entry point is an internal implementation-policy choice.

items.title: `sdd-forge.flow` skill が明示されているため、該当手順だけ確認して、この依頼がフロー操作ではなく QA 構造チェックである前提で進めます。指定されたローカル skill パスがこの worktree には存在しないようです。依頼内容自体は有限な構造レビューなので、提示された QA だけを対象に判定します。### 1. q1 includes rationale
items.rationale: q1 is still a valid goal-confirmation question, but the current text includes explanatory rationale about test-execute-result.json. The repair step can keep the decision point and remove the rationale.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[0].question contains a second sentence explaining the existing test-execute contract.

items.title: 2. q3 includes a proposed answer shape
items.rationale: q3 is still a valid acceptance-criteria question, but it currently embeds a proposed raw-log and summary-count shape. The repair step can ask only what states must be distinguishable.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[2].question proposes raw log path and summary counts inside the pending question.

items.title: 3. q4 asks internal implementation details and includes rationale
items.rationale: The artifact generation entry point is an internal implementation-policy detail that should be resolved from existing CLI and flow patterns during spec writing, not asked as a user-facing draft question.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[3].question asks whether to implement artifact generation in sdd-forge upgrade itself or in a flow-specific command.
